checkpoint_selection: earliest strict minimum validation-family macro MAE, all 40 epochs
training_sampling: uniform family, uniform endpoint within family, N draws per epoch
scaling: equal training family and node type, valid timesteps only; masked channels remain zero

crossfit.epoch_policy: fixed selected full-parent epoch, no held-family selection
crossfit.fold_scaling: fitted only to the fold's training families
crossfit.gate_supervision: Stage21 advantage sign, BCE weighted by 0.02 + absolute scaled advantage

lightweight.dyt: gamma*tanh(alpha*x)+beta; four temporal LayerNorms replaced; alpha=0.5 scalar per norm; gamma=1 beta=0 per channel
lightweight.kan: two edge-function layers 64->32->64, phi=c1*tanh(x)+c2*(2*tanh(x)^2-1); output bias; no T0 edge coefficient (absorbed by output bias); no extra ReLU; original FFN dropout retained
lightweight.kan_initialization: independent Normal(0,1/sqrt(2*input_width)) coefficients; zero output biases
lightweight.head: signed power-of-two QAT with identity STE, exponents rounded log2(abs(master_weight)), bounded [-8,0], bias retained; independent ldexp+where+sum inference; no Linear or matmul in head
lightweight.head_init: uniform +/-1/sqrt(width) weights and bias, matching dense head marginal initialization
lightweight.attention: unchanged 64-wide four-head two-layer temporal attention and post-norm residual topology
